verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains only marketing language such as "high-performance LLMs" and a Performance Client for sending concurrent requests. It shows no published tokens-per-second or latency figures, no benchmarks, and no load-testing guide backing the speed claims. The Performance Client is a throughput-oriented client, not a published benchmark or load-testing methodology, so it is only adjacent.

support.subject: As an ml-engineer, I can see published tokens-per-second or latency numbers, benchmarks, or load-testing guides backing the provider's speed claims
